textRuns.value: Native inspections are not mapped to manual checklist templates. Closed does not mean every item was inspected. Blanks are unknown. Month filters use inspection date and exclude undated records; clear the month filter to include them.

Literal.Value: 'Native inspections are not mapped to manual checklist templates. Closed does not mean every item was inspected. Blanks are unknown. Month filters use inspection date and exclude undated records; clear the month filter to include them.'
